title: Default scene: the model is the smallest thing on screen
caption: On open, the stage gets about 44% of the window width and a third of that is covered by the video window, a toast, a tooltip and labels. Mission promised the stage as the hero.

callouts.note: Video window floats open by default over a quarter of the stage. Open it on demand, or dock it as a strip above the timeline.
'Preparing survey surfaces' toast stacks on the video window. Move job progress to the status bar's jobs chip, and put toasts in one corner that never overlaps.
'Collapse the timeline' tooltip still showing after the pointer left. Hide tooltips on pointer leave and on focus change.
The loudest element in the app is 'Create maps from photos', which is an occasional job. Move it to Projects and the Processing panel. In the sidebar, show at most a quiet secondary action.
Hint card sits inside the dataset tree and pushes Models, Video and Photos below the fold. Show it as a one-line banner, or as a badge on the 'Every date' row.
'Pile 02 · 329.6 m³' label is clipped by the right panel edge. Clamp labels to the stage bounds.
The Volumes table has right-aligned mono figures, signed and coloured deltas, and a material group row. This is precise survey UI.

title: At 1100 x 720 the stage is a 390 px slot
caption: At the CI window size the side panels keep their full width, so the 3D view shrinks to a column. The video covers most of it and the Show control wraps.

callouts.note: The stage is 390 px wide, 35% of the window. Below about 1280 px, auto-collapse the dataset tree to the 52 px rail and narrow the right panel to 320 px.
The video window covers about 70% of the stage width. At this size, dock it into the bottom strip.
'Cut & fill' wraps onto two lines inside the segmented control. Use one line with an ellipsis, or move this control into the right panel.
Pile labels are cut by the right panel. Collapse them to dots when they are off-stage.
An 'Annotate 0:00.0' chip sits on top of the video picture.

title: The island drops over the top third of the stage
caption: The notch opens into a 460 x 210 px tool panel over the model and pushes the Show control down. Its group tabs are icons only.

callouts.note: The open island covers the top of the model, which is where the user is aiming. Open it as a single 44 px toolbar row, with the large-icon grid only on request.
Five tool groups are icon-only (ruler, layers, cloud, terrain, video). Label them, or show the group name on hover as well as on focus.
The Show control (Photo, Elevation, Cut & fill) moves to make room and now collides with the model. Give stage overlays fixed slots.
The toggled state on Timeline and Right panel is clear: a tinted fill with a border, not colour alone.

title: Active group label lies
caption: Hovering the annotate group shows the annotate tools, but the label still reads 'View'.

callouts.note: The highlighted label says 'View' while the row shows Annotate tools. The labelled pill should follow the group being previewed.
'All tools' opens a third tool catalogue: see the Project tab and the armed-tool chips.

title: Right panel tabs reshuffle themselves
caption: Opening a tool group from the island adds a pinned tab, pushes Issues, Volumes and Changes into an overflow menu, and narrows the panel from 470 px to 360 px.

callouts.note: The tab set changes with each tool: 'Annotate' plus pin and close is inserted at the front. Keep the core tabs fixed and open tools in a sub-view inside a fixed Tools tab.
Issues and Volumes, two of the main reasons to open a project, are hidden behind '··· 3'.
The 'Selection' tab shows the project when nothing is selected. Show an empty state ('Click an asset, issue or pile') instead.
This panel is 360 px wide; on the Volumes tab it is 470 px. Fix one width that the user can resize and that is remembered.

title: Armed tool: good feedback, a second tool catalogue
caption: The tool card and the island chip show clearly which tool is armed. Below them, the grouped tool list turns into a cloud of 18 chips.

callouts.note: The tool card states the step ('Click on the site'), shows live values, and has Undo, Stop and Save with their keys.
The island shows the armed tool as a chip, so the state is visible on the stage itself.
The same tools now appear as 18 ungrouped chips, while before arming they were 10 accordions. Keep one tool list, grouped the same way everywhere.
'Autosave / Save' is about measurements but sits in the tool area. Move it next to the Measurements list.

title: Project switcher shows one letter per project
caption: The customer column takes the width, so the project names, which are what you switch by, are cut to 'D...'.

callouts.note: Project names are cut to one letter. Put the name first at full width with the customer as a second line, or drop the customer column inside one customer.
'Audit trail' is a project-level page hidden in a switcher menu. It belongs in the project's own area, for example the Reports screen.

title: Command palette does not know the tools
caption: Typing 'measure' returns two exports, not Distance, Area, Volume or Elevation.

callouts.note: The palette does not index the scene tools. Add every tool and every right-panel tab as commands with their shortcuts, for example 'Distance  M'.

title: Issues register: solid rows, heavy filter chrome
caption: The rows are well built. The filters take two lines of eight controls before the first issue, and the list ends halfway down a mostly empty column.

callouts.note: Eight filter controls in two rows (severity chips, search, classes, status, dataset, Mine, My work, sort, grouping). Keep search, severity and status visible and put the rest under a Filters button.
Mono codes, plain titles, class and evidence metadata, and severity badges with a number and colour: scannable.
F02 and F05 codes turn orange (draft?) with no legend. Show the state as a word or an icon as well as the colour.
'Create maps from photos' is still the primary button on the Issues screen.

title: Status bar says Cloud AI while no AI can run
caption: The footer shows a green 'Cloud AI' dot. The same screen says 'No AI can look at this' and 'Cannot run yet'.

callouts.note: Green 'Cloud AI' means 'allowed', not 'working'. Show 'AI off' or 'No key' in amber when nothing can run.
The 'No AI' notice takes the photo toolbar band. Show it once in the Ask AI button's disabled state or tooltip.
The 'Class: Pick at acc…' and 'Severity: Pick at a…' dropdowns are truncated. Stack them, or shorten the labels to 'Class' and 'Severity'.
The blocked state says why it is blocked and links to the fix, and the Run button is disabled.

title: Globe: decorative atmosphere, marker on its label
caption: The starfield and blue rim glow belong to a consumer earth viewer. The cluster dot is drawn over its own text.

callouts.note: The cluster dot sits on its label, so '3 sites' reads '3•tes'. Offset the dot to the left of the text.
Starfield and glowing atmosphere are decoration ('decorative neon' anti-reference). Use a flat dark sphere with a hairline limb.
The 'Photo processing demo' label hangs off the globe limb. Hide labels for back-facing or limb sites.

title: Library: onboarding card owns the fold
caption: A 520 px welcome card fills the screen, and it stays there after setup and while a project is open (37). The projects themselves start at the bottom edge.

callouts.note: The welcome card is permanent and pushes the project cards below the fold. Collapse it to a one-line 'Set up this workstation (2 of 4)' strip once a project exists.
The project cards, the main content of this screen, are only 50 px into view.
The data folder and map packs repeat what the welcome card says, in a third column. Show them once.
New project is the single primary action, placed where expected.

title: Settings: run-together text, odd toggle placement
caption: The title and description of one setting run together, and its toggle sits below the text instead of at the right like every other toggle.

callouts.note: '…when a project opensRuns in the background…' has no space. Put the description on its own line, as elsewhere.
The toggle sits under the text. Align it right, as for 'Graphics card' just above.
One primary action per card, with the cost stated (234 MB, 1.0 GB installed) and the licence linked.

title: Compare dates at 1100 x 720 breaks
caption: Two 190 px panes, a clipped island and overlapping chips. The Changes tab next to it offers six run buttons of equal weight.

callouts.note: The island is clipped off the top-left of the stage. Centre it over the full stage, not over one pane.
The pane header '3D view' is cut to '3…'. Drop the view name or the date at this width.
The 'Can't line up' chip floats over both panes with no explanation. Attach it to the divider and add an action ('Align dates…').
Six run buttons of similar weight. Keep 'Find changes' as the one primary action and put the per-kind runs in its split menu.
The 'How compare works' link is drawn over the stage under the island.

title: Road project opens on an empty black map
caption: The fit leaves the 300 m corridor as a strip in the top-left corner. The chainage strip below is the best idea on the screen.

callouts.note: Fit to data on open: the road should fill the stage width, rotated along the corridor if needed.
About 75% of the stage is black. Without a map pack, use a subtle grid and the ortho extent, not a void.
Fourteen filter chips (3 severities and 11 defect types) before the list. Make severity the chips and defect type a dropdown.
The chainage histogram by severity, with click to go and drag to filter, is a domain-specific control that earns its place.

title: Processing panel: clear blocked state, risky button row
caption: The panel states why processing cannot run and offers the fix. 'Create maps from photos' now appears twice on screen, and 'Delete run' sits beside benign actions.

callouts.note: The blocked state gives the reason and the fix ('Update processing tools') in one place.
A second 'Create maps from photos' button, also in the sidebar at the top left. Keep this one and remove the sidebar one.
'Delete run' is the only outlined button in a row of text buttons, next to 'Delete work files'. Move destructive actions into a ··· menu with confirmation.
The panel overlays the map and cuts the 'Streets' control at its edge.

title: Layer right-click menu: 15 items
caption: Every action is reachable, as the founder asked, but the menu is as tall as the window.

callouts.note: Fifteen items in five groups run to the window edge. Keep Hide, Zoom to, Rename, File under ▸ and Delete at the top level and move the georeferencing actions into a 'Position ▸' submenu.
The date options take three rows. Make 'File under' a submenu.

title: Collapsed rail gives the model room
caption: With the left sidebar collapsed, the stage gains about 200 px and the scene reads as a workspace. This should be the default below 1440 px.

callouts.note: The stage at 770 px wide: the model, labels and piles fit without clipping.
The teal 'Create maps' icon stays the brightest thing in the rail.
The hint card floats mid-stage over the model. Anchor hints to the bottom-left status slot.
